# Brand

**Languages and direction:** French (LTR), English (LTR).
**AI-imagery disclosure rule:** every generated or altered image carries the small corner badge "Image generated by AI" on the asset, and the ad sets the AI self-disclosure OPT_IN at the creative level.
**Do-not-do:** no generated image is presented as a real project, address or apartment.
